items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I don't clearly remember that. I know he was around.

ctx.x: Oh, he's a wonderful fellow. Wonderful fellow. Very personable drummer -- -- terrific drummer terrific personality, everything. He's one of our best.
Did -- did the time that you were in Redman Redmond's band with Pearl, was John Sully the road manager, I know at one point he was the road manager for his Pearls band. Was it at that time?
No, I don't think so. I don't remember.
